maddeler.e:
نتململ (form IIq)
# نَتَمَلْمَلُ (natamalmalu) /na.ta.mal.ma.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَمَلْمَلَ (tamalmala)
# نَتَمَلْمَلَ (natamalmala) /na.ta.mal.ma.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَمَلْمَلَ (tamalmala)
# نَتَمَلْمَلْ (natamalmal) /na.ta.mal.mal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَمَلْمَلَ (tamalmala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
